node.statement: Signed-row subset ledger. For every row i and every subset S of I, -t <= P_i(S) <= 1+t and ||p_i||_1 <= 1+2t. Indeed, set P_{ij}^+:=max(P_{ij},0) and P_{ij}^-:=max(-P_{ij},0). The registered exact-signed-idempotent definition gives sum_j P_{ij}=1, while the registered negative-mass definition and the root hypothesis give sum_j P_{ij}^-=nu_i<=t. Hence sum_j P_{ij}^+=1+nu_i. Therefore -nu_i <= -sum_{j in S}P_{ij}^- <= P_i(S) <= sum_{j in S}P_{ij}^+ <= 1+nu_i, proving the subset bounds; also ||p_i||_1=sum_j(P_{ij}^++P_{ij}^-)=1+2nu_i<=1+2t.
